findings.source_quote:
A princess of God!
It’s a calling sublime
That merits my giving
Of talent and time
To grow in the glory
Of what He would make--
My Father, the King,
Will all ugliness take
Away from my heart,
That it tarnish no more
And bring me the jewels
That He has in store.

findings.translation_quote:
¡Una princesa de Dios!
Es un llamado sublime
que merece que ofrezca mi talento y mi tiempo, para crecer en la gloria de lo que Él quiere hacer de mí. Mi Padre, el Rey, quitará toda fealdad de mi corazón, para que ya no lo empañe, y me traerá las joyas que tiene reservadas.

findings.source_quote:
A princess of God!
It’s a calling to live
A life that to others
Around me would give
A diamond of hope,
A desire for God,
The truth of salvation
By Jesus’ shed blood.
A call to live godly
In Jesus Christ,
Adorned with His meekness
And clothed with His light.
